joinUs.stripSubtitle: Help build the future of municipal digital services through technology
joinUs.title: Join Us
joinUs.heroTitle: Help Build the Future of Civic Tech in Morong
joinUs.heroSubtitle: BetterMorong is an independent, open-source civic portal providing citizens with fast, transparent, and politics-free access to municipal services, emergency hotlines, and public documents.
joinUs.tracksHeading: There’s a Place for Every Skill Set
joinUs.tracksSubtitle: You don’t have to be a programmer to contribute. We need researchers, writers, designers, and local community advocates.
joinUs.devDesc: Contribute with modern React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, and offline-first PWA caching for typhoon mode.
joinUs.contentDesc: Turn complex bureaucratic ordinances and the Citizen’s Charter into plain-language, bilingual step-by-step guides.
joinUs.designDesc: Help ensure BetterMorong meets WCAG 2.1 AA/AAA accessibility standards, screen readers, and low-bandwidth mobile devices.
joinUs.communityDesc: Share printed guides with senior citizens, test usability across Morong’s 8 barangays, and collect resident feedback.
joinUs.antiEpalDesc: We strictly prohibit politician names, faces, or partisan taglines. Public services belong to the people and are delivered by municipal institutions.
joinUs.privacyDesc: No user tracking, ad pixels, or personal data collection. Tools like our Cedula and Amilyar fee calculators run 100% locally in the browser.
joinUs.offlineDesc: During typhoons, flooding along Laguna de Bay, or cellular network outages, emergency hotlines and evacuation guides remain accessible offline.
joinUs.freeTitle: Zero Cost to the Taxpayers of Morong
joinUs.freeDesc: Built entirely with volunteer labor and deployed on free-tier, modern edge infrastructure. Cost to the municipal treasury: ₱0.00.
joinUs.bannerSubtitle: Help build the future of local government services through open technology.

estimator.title: Morong Municipal Tax & Fee Estimator
estimator.subtitle: Instant client-side estimates for Cedula (CTC) and Real Property Tax (Amilyar)
estimator.propertyAssessedLabel: Real Property Owned in PH (Assessed Value, Optional)
estimator.latePaymentLabel: Paid after last day of February (Late Filing Penalty)
estimator.cedulaNote: Statutory maximum additional tax on income is capped at ₱5,000.00 by law.
estimator.assessedHelpTitle: Where to find your Assessed Value:
estimator.assessedHelpBody: Check your official Morong Tax Declaration (TD) under 'Assessed Value' (not Market Value). Assessed Value is already scaled by the municipal assessment level (e.g., 20% for residential land).
estimator.promptDiscountLabel: Apply Prompt Payment Discount (10% standard early payment)
estimator.promptDiscountHelp: Granted by the LGU when full annual amilyar or quarterly dues are settled on or before statutory due dates.
estimator.disclaimerBody: This fee calculator provides indicative estimates based on Republic Act No. 7160 (Local Government Code). Official tax assessments, municipal tax ordinance relief, prior-year delinquency penalties, and official receipts are exclusively processed by the Morong Municipal Treasurer’s Office at Municipal Hall.
